terms.comment: Our description, a framework for climbing: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a climbing frame (searched also under jungle gym and monkey bars). Compāgēs is classically a joining together, a structure (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: compages · Lewis & Short: scando
Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
